annotations.title: Find escrow-enabled pros for a job

description: Read-only. With contractor_slug, checks whether that pro can receive a quote request; otherwise picks up to 3 escrow-enabled pros near the ZIP for the job. Returns each pro with a prefilled RateDeed link for homeowners without a linked account. With a linked account, send the request directly with submit_quote_request. Nothing is sent or charged by this tool.

contractor_slug.description: Optional: a specific contractor from search_contractors.

project_description.description: Details the contractor needs: what, where, size, timing.

project_title.description: Short title, e.g. "Replace leaking kitchen faucet".

trade.description: Trade for the job, if known.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property.

name: start_hire
